{{Quote|We're hemorrhaging more mercs every day to the Republic. Nova Guard, Crimson Brotherhood... this keeps up, we'll lose our foothold, our entire slave trade. The mercenaries need to realize the consequences of a Republic partnership. We need to send them a message, written in blood.|Eliss Pim|<ref name="TOR:AMftM" />}}
'''Eliss Pim''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3643 BBY]], he asked a fellow Imperial to crush the [[Nova Guard]] and [[Crimson Brotherhood]] mercenary gangs, which abandoned the Empire and went to work for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR:AMftM" />
